title: How I Build an Elite Creative Strategy for a Brand in One Sitting
description:
Thanks to Storyblocks for sponsoring this video. Get 15% off any annual plan for a limited time, only available through this link: https://storyblocks.com/DaraDenney

Want to work with me? Let's talk: https://form.typeform.com/to/JpKG4ydU

If your creative strategy starts with spying on competitors, you’re already behind.

In this video, I break down the exact creative strategy process my agency uses to build winning Meta ad strategies for DTC brands. Instead of copying what’s already working, you’ll learn how to uncover hidden opportunities through customer research, review mining, reputation analysis, AI-powered insights, and persona development.

You’ll see the same framework we’ve used across hundreds of ecommerce brands to identify creative gaps, build better ad concepts, and create a scalable creative roadmap that actually drives performance.

In this video, you’ll learn:
• Why competitor research isn’t creative strategy
• How to conduct a reputation analysis
• My customer review mining process
• Using AI to uncover winning personas and messaging
• Finding the biggest creative gaps in any ad account
• Building a monthly and quarterly creative roadmap
• Real examples from brands like Oats Overnight, Rhode, and Grüns

Whether you’re a creative strategist, media buyer, founder, or performance marketer, this framework will help you create more effective ads and build a stronger creative system.
